title: Dashboard
label: Dashboard
summary: sidebar dashboard with overview and settings
description: A sidebar dashboard inside /account: overview with stat cards and a table, a settings page, and a user menu with sign out. Requires auth.
notes: Open /account after signing in. The sidebar, header and guard live in src/routes/account.tsx.
Add a page: create src/routes/account/<name>.tsx, then add it to the items list in src/components/app-sidebar.tsx and to titles in src/routes/account.tsx.
The numbers and orders on the overview are placeholders.
